description: The bar chart illustrates the Shapley values for three multilingual models—mBERT (light blue), XLM-R (dark blue), and chLSTM (light green)—across various linguistic positions labeled L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, likely representing left and right contextual positions relative to a target token (T). The vertical axis, labeled “Shapley value,” ranges from 0 to 80 with major gridlines at intervals of 20. The horizontal axis lists the positions in order from leftmost (L₄⁺) to rightmost (R₄⁺), with T at the center. The tallest bar corresponds to chLSTM at position T, reaching approximately 79, followed by mBERT at T (~59) and XLM-R at T (~55). At position L₁, all three models show moderate values (~14–16), while at R₁, values are lower (~10–12). Positions L₂, L₃, L₄⁺, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺ show consistently low Shapley values across all models, mostly under 5, with chLSTM occasionally near zero. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of the target position (T) for all models, particularly for chLSTM, and suggests diminishing contribution from more distant contextual positions. The legend in the upper right identifies each model by color, and all bars are grouped by position with consistent spacing and no stacking.
